name: Oose no Mama ni ★ Goshujin-sama!
original_name: 仰せのままに★ご主人様!
source:
Ousuke is a rich businessman living in a luxury hotel suite. At a fancy party, another wealthy man brags to him about his many maids. He says, "A man who can't deal with maids cannot call himself a high-class man." So Ousuke decides to buy a house and recruit some maids...

[Translated from [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E4%BB%B0%E3%81%9B%E3%81%AE%E3%81%BE%E3%81%BE%E3%81%AB%E2%98%85%E3%81%94%E4%B8%BB%E4%BA%BA%E6%A7%98!]Japanese Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
旺介是一名富商，住在豪华酒店的套房里。在一场奢华宴会上，另一位富人向他夸耀自己拥有许多女仆，还说道："连女仆都驾驭不了的男人，根本称不上上流人士。"于是，旺介决定买下一栋房子，招募几名女仆…

[翻译自[url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E4%BB%B0%E3%81%9B%E3%81%AE%E3%81%BE%E3%81%BE%E3%81%AB%E2%98%85%E3%81%94%E4%B8%BB%E4%BA%BA%E6%A7%98!]日语维基百科[/url]]
